subject.title: [Feature]: Allow pinning plugin tabs in the Control UI sidebar

question: Should the Control UI’s persisted customizable sidebar support plugin-tab entries as first-class user pins, rather than treating all plugin tabs as More-only destinations?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but it establishes a durable core UI preference and navigation contract for all plugins, including behavior when a descriptor disappears or changes.

options.title: Approve the generic sidebar entry
options.body: Add a stable plugin-tab entry variant and define unavailable-plugin, deduplication, active-state, and More-filtering behavior in focused Control UI tests.

options.title: Keep plugin tabs in More
options.body: Retain the existing route/session-only customization model and document that plugin tabs are intentionally secondary navigation surfaces.

options.title: Defer behind a sidebar redesign
options.body: Leave this request open but postpone the preference-model expansion until the broader navigation direction is decided.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic sidebar entry
recommendation.body: Add a stable plugin-tab entry variant and define unavailable-plugin, deduplication, active-state, and More-filtering behavior in focused Control UI tests.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md ownership is the strongest available signal for the web-frontend ergonomics and core-versus-plugin boundary decision.
